content.text:
I read the spec and the repository: it has only a README, so the plan starts from the tooling.

<plan>
{
  "tickets": [
    {
      "id": "T01",
      "title": "Repository and tooling",
      "phase": 0,
      "purpose": "Set up the repository so every later ticket has lint, tests and CI from the start.",
      "depends_on": [],
      "estimate_h": 1.5,
      "review_required": true,
      "scope": [
        "Monorepo layout with lint, format, type-check and test commands, and CI."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "`just lint` and `just test` pass in CI",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T02",
      "title": "Backend scaffold",
      "phase": 0,
      "purpose": "Give the backend a running FastAPI app that later routes build on.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T01"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 1.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "FastAPI app with a health route, settings and logging."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "`GET /api/health` returns 200",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T03",
      "title": "Frontend scaffold",
      "phase": 0,
      "purpose": "Give the frontend a React app that talks to the backend.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T02"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 1.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "React app with routing, the design tokens and an API client."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "The app builds and shows the backend's health",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T04",
      "title": "Database layer and schema",
      "phase": 1,
      "purpose": "Store runs, revisions and results in SQLite with migrations.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T02"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": true,
      "scope": [
        "SQLite schema for runs, revisions and results, with migrations."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Migrations create the schema from scratch",
        "A test inserts and reads back a run",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T05",
      "title": "Assessment logic",
      "phase": 1,
      "purpose": "Decide each result's verdict with pure, tested rules.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T01"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 1.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Pure functions that turn a result into a pass, warn or fail verdict."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Every verdict rule has a test",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T06",
      "title": "CSV parsing and validation",
      "phase": 1,
      "purpose": "Read result CSVs and report bad rows instead of dropping them.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T02"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Read result CSVs and report bad rows with their line numbers."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Malformed rows are reported, not dropped silently",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T07",
      "title": "Ingestion and sync",
      "phase": 1,
      "purpose": "Load the CSV folders into the database and keep them in sync.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T04",
        "T05",
        "T06"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 3,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Import CSV folders into the database and keep them in sync."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Re-running the import changes nothing",
        "A changed file updates its rows",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T08",
      "title": "Discovery and results API",
      "phase": 2,
      "purpose": "Let the frontend list revisions and fetch their results.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T07"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Routes to list revisions and fetch their results."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "`GET /api/revisions` lists every imported revision",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T09",
      "title": "Comparison API",
      "phase": 2,
      "purpose": "Compare two revisions result by result on the backend.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T08"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "A route that compares two revisions result by result."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "The comparison marks improved, regressed and unchanged results",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T10",
      "title": "Demands API",
      "phase": 2,
      "purpose": "Let team leads manage the demands results are checked against.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T08"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 3,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Create, edit and delete demands that results are checked against."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Demands round-trip through the API",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T11",
      "title": "App shell and routing",
      "phase": 3,
      "purpose": "Give the app its navigation, layout and page routes.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T03",
        "T08"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Navigation, layout and the routes for the three pages."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Every page is reachable from the navigation",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T12",
      "title": "Shared chart and verdict components",
      "phase": 3,
      "purpose": "Build the chart, verdict badge and table every page uses.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T11"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 3,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Chart, verdict badge and table components used by every page."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Components render in light and dark themes",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T13",
      "title": "Revisions page",
      "phase": 3,
      "purpose": "Show revisions with their verdicts and drill into one.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T12"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "List revisions with their verdicts and drill into one."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Selecting a revision shows its results",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T14",
      "title": "Compare page",
      "phase": 3,
      "purpose": "Show two revisions side by side and highlight regressions.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T12",
        "T09"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 3,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Pick two revisions and show the comparison as a table and chart."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Regressions are highlighted",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T15",
      "title": "Demands page and dialogs",
      "phase": 3,
      "purpose": "Manage demands from the UI with dialogs.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T12",
        "T10"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 3.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Manage demands with create, edit and delete dialogs."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Changes in a dialog show up without a reload",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T16",
      "title": "Bad-data handling pass",
      "phase": 4,
      "purpose": "Make every page cope with empty, partial and malformed data.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T13",
        "T14",
        "T15"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 1.5,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Every page handles empty, partial and malformed data gracefully."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "No page crashes on the bad-data fixtures",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T17",
      "title": "Test completion",
      "phase": 4,
      "purpose": "Close the gaps in unit and end-to-end tests.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T16"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "Fill the gaps in unit and end-to-end tests."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "Coverage meets the agreed floor",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T18",
      "title": "Documentation and handover",
      "phase": 4,
      "purpose": "Document the app so a new developer can run and maintain it.",
      "depends_on": [
        "T17"
      ],
      "estimate_h": 2,
      "review_required": false,
      "scope": [
        "README, user guide and a handover note for maintainers."
      ],
      "done_when": [
        "A new developer can set up and run the app from the README",
        "`just test` passes"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</plan>
